text: 68-year-old smoker with COPD, three days of worse breathlessness, yellow sputum and low fever. Denies chest pain. No penicillin allergy. COPD and hypertension. No infective exacerbation. Saturation 91% on room air, respiratory rate 24, pulse 98 beats per minute, blood pressure 138/84 mmHg, temperature 100 degrees Fahrenheit. Chest x-ray and sputum culture. Controlled oxygen, nebulized salbutamol, tiotropium, azithromycin 500 mg daily three days. Smoking cessation. Diet, small frequent high-protein meals. Warm water, avoid smoke. General. purse delip breathing.Daily walks. Emergency for blue lips or drowsiness. Fol up in three days.
